comments.author: @wyodrifter9452
comments.text: Geoff states that the Yellowstone Hotspot passed under Idaho on its way to its current location under Wyoming. Not true! The Yellowstone Hotspot is in a fixed location and the North American plate travels in a Southwestern direction over the top of the Hotspot. Each caldera left by a Yellowstone eruption then moved away from the Hotspot towards the SW leaving a lower elevation from which water was able to travel and thus created the Snake River Canyon across Southern Idaho.
